from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0006.png'))
# Chair is brown wood: col ~ 300 to 400
chair_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 100) & (img[:, :, 2] < 50)
chair_mask[:, :250] = False # exclude jug
ys, xs = np.where(chair_mask)
print('Chair xs in obs_0006:', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'ys:', ys.min(), ys.max())

# Floor contact of legs:
print('Lowest rows of chair legs in obs_0006:')
for r in range(ys.max()-5, ys.max()+1):
    cols = xs[ys == r]
    print(f'row {r}: {cols.tolist()}')
"", "description": "Find chair contact points in obs_0006"}
